candidates.name: Smiti Mandana
candidates.title: UI Designer
candidates.summary:
Creative and detail-oriented UI Designer with 2+ years of experience designing intuitive and
visually engaging digital interfaces. Skilled in user interface design, design systems,
wireframing, prototyping, and responsive web design. Experienced in collaborating with
developers and product teams to create user-friendly digital experiences.
DESIGN SKILLS
UI Design: Web Design, Mobile App Design, Responsive Design, Design Systems, Visual
Design
UX: Wireframing, User Flows, User Research, Information Architecture, Usability Testing
Design Tools: Figma, Adobe XD, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Canva
Prototyping: Interactive Prototypes, High-Fidelity Prototypes, Micro-interactions
Other Skills: Typography, Color Theory, Layout Design, Accessibility, Design Thinking
Basic Technical: HTML, CSS, JavaScript

experience.title: UI Designer — PixelCraft Studio
experience.details: UI Designer — PixelCraft Studio | Mumbai, India | August 2024 – Present
bullets: Designed responsive web and mobile interfaces for multiple client projects.
Created wireframes, high-fidelity screens, and interactive prototypes using Figma.
Developed reusable UI components and maintained design systems.
Collaborated with developers to ensure accurate implementation of designs.
Conducted usability testing and improved interfaces based on user feedback.
Created landing pages, dashboards, mobile applications, and marketing websites.

bullets: Assisted senior designers in creating web and mobile application interfaces.
Designed wireframes and user flows for new product features.
